name: goalpost
description: Read projects, author draft change batches, and manage project team access in Goalpost — shared, versioned project documents for people and agents, from inside Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Shared, versioned project documents for people and agents, inside your AI assistant.
interface.longDescription: Connect Goalpost — shared, versioned project documents for people and agents — to Codex. The assistant can list projects, read the latest approved version of a project, draft and revise change batches, submit drafts for approval, and manage project-level team access. Approving and rejecting votes, configuring approval rules, and team membership are out of scope and must be done in the Goalpost webapp.
